mentions.name: KineVision
mentions.description: An iOS sport video analysis app for coaching, in the style of Coach's Eye, that lets users analyze sports footage. It is kept 100% free for now while the builder seeks power users and retention, with no monetization until it proves helpful.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm building KineVision, a sport video analysis app for iOS. Something like Coach's Eye.
